title.en: An Act Granting to "Butuan Saw Mill, Inc.," a Franchise to Install, Operate, and Maintain An Electric Light, Heat and Power Plant in the Municipalities of Jimenez, Province of Occidental Misamis, and Maasin, Province of Leyte, Philippine Islands.

text.en:
Subject to the rules and conditions established in Act Numbered Thirty-six hundred and
thirty-six, there is hereby granted to "Butuan Saw Mill, Inc.," for a period of fifty years from the approval of
this Act, the right, privilege and authority to construct, maintain and operate an electric light, heat and power
system for the purpose of generating and distributing electric light, heat and power, for sale within the limits
of the municipalities of Jimenez, Province of Occidental Misamis, and Maasin, Province of Leyte, Philippine

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, December 4, 1930.
